rationale:
The requirement `requirements.sdk.graph.validation-context.outgoing_edges.mcp.description` fixes one thing: the description string of the `outgoing_edges` MCP tool. The text is "Inspect a known node's outgoing targets for the requested label, making those targets available to read_node." The line break in the requirement is only wrapping.

`crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/tools.rs#impl[GraphSession<'_, '_, D>/Conversation]/fn[tools]` builds the `outgoing_edges` tool definition. Its `"description"` is exactly that sentence. The function carries the `{impl}` reference for this requirement. It is the only item that needs the reference, because it is where the description is produced. It also sets the tool's `parameters` through `edge_parameters::<D::EdgeLabel>(&path)`, and that is outside this requirement.

I found no structural gap. There are no acknowledgments and none are needed. This was a structural check only. I did not run a separate behavioral or test-adequacy assessment.
